visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young boy standing in a doorway of a home, wearing white pajamas. He makes playful hand gestures over his eyes as if applying something. A woman wearing a white tank top suddenly peeks out from behind the door, holding a pink toothbrush and smiling widely at the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a bathroom where the boy has a toothbrush attached to a violin bow in his mouth. He uses another bow to 'play' the toothbrush bow. The woman stands beside him, holding her own green toothbrush, pointing and speaking with exaggerated expressions. The lighting is bright and the background shows a tiled bathroom wall and mirror. (3) A fast-paced montage sequence shows various close-up shots of the woman and boy brushing their teeth with high energy. The woman's facial expressions are comedic and intense. Pink toothpaste is seen on the brushes. Text overlays and graphic effects like speed lines appear frequently. (4) The woman holds up a tube of Euthymol toothpaste. The camera zooms in on the product. The scene shifts to the woman standing outdoors on a London street in a brown jacket, then back to the bathroom. Detailed close-ups show the aluminum tube and the pink paste being squeezed out. The boy is seen again at the end, smiling and showing his clean teeth.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An upbeat, high-tempo pop track with synthesized strings and a strong rhythmic beat begins immediately. A woman's voice is heard speaking with high arousal and a bright, friendly tone. The audio is crisp and clearly studio-processed with no background noise. (2) A distinct violin melody enters the mix, mimicking a fast tremolo. The woman's speech rate increases as she enthusiastically explains the 'violin brushing' technique. Short, percussive 'pop' sound effects are synchronized with visual cuts and the appearance of variety-show style text on screen. (3) A brief 'heavenly' choral synthesizer swell occurs as the product tube is showcased, creating a sense of dramatic reveal. The woman's voice transitions to a professional, narrative delivery style, although still maintaining a high positive valence. The background music continues at a moderate volume. (4) A series of quick 'whoosh' transition sound effects mark the shifts between bathroom scenes and the outdoor London scene. The primary vocal remains the woman's narration, providing information about the brand's history and ingredients. A final comedic 'ding' sound effect plays as the boy smiles.
